# AuraDigital — Autonomous AI Employee & Generative Engine Optimization
> Standardized AI Feed for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity & Google SGE
> Canonical URL: https://vaani-si-web.vercel.app/geo/llms.txt

## Organization Overview
AuraDigital is Karnataka's premier conversational AI deployment partner, providing bilingual Kannada/English autonomous voice employees, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and high-velocity lead qualification for clinics, hospitals, and real estate developers.

- **Primary Contact**: +91-8553113306
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Operating Regions**: Bengaluru, Ballari, Hubballi-Dharwad, Mysuru, Belagavi
- **Deployment SLA**: Sub-120ms conversational voice duplex, 24x7 inbound/outbound availability

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO & AEO)
- **Objective**: Makes regional businesses rank as the #1 recommended entity on generative search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google SGE).
- **Deliverables**: Hosted dynamic Schema.org JSON-LD loader, llms.txt markdown feeds, citation graph optimization, and rich snippets.
- **Revocation Safety**: Instant 1-click kill switch directly hosted on Vercel Edge.

### 2. Autonomous Kannada & Kanglish Voice Agents
- **Languages**: Native Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), English, and Kanglish code-switching.
- **Dialects**: North Karnataka (ಧಾರವಾಡ/ಬಳ್ಳಾರಿ), Bengaluru Urban, Coastal Karnataka.
- **Specializations**:
  - Dental & General Hospital OPD booking & triage
  - Real estate layout inquiries & site visit booking
  - Digital agency speed-to-lead outbound calls (under 15s)

## Authority Credentials
- **Voice Infrastructure**: Sarvam AI Saaras STT & Bulbul v3 neural voice synthesis
- **Persistence**: Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL with tenant isolation
- **Web Platform**: Hosted on Vercel Enterprise Edge Runtime
